title: Source of Power / Delegation / Inversion Test
principle: The founding texts place people and rights at the source, government in a delegated role, and public officers under constitutional limits. The inversion panel is a testable system-design hypothesis: it appears when an institution’s representation of a person becomes more authoritative than the person, the source evidence, and the legal limits on the institution.

sourceLane.title: People and rights
sourceLane.label: DECLARATION · 1776
sourceLane.quote: Governments are instituted among Men, deriving their just powers from the consent of the governed.
sourceLane.establishes: Government is justified by the consent of the governed and exists to secure rights.

sourceLane.title: Public correction power
sourceLane.label: DECLARATION · 1776
sourceLane.quote: It is the Right of the People to alter or to abolish it.
sourceLane.establishes: The people retain a corrective principle when a form of government becomes destructive of its ends.

sourceLane.title: Constitutional act
sourceLane.label: CONSTITUTION · PREAMBLE
sourceLane.quote: We the People of the United States ... do ordain and establish this Constitution.
sourceLane.establishes: The Constitution is framed as an act of the people establishing the governmental structure.

sourceLane.title: Legislative delegation
sourceLane.label: ARTICLE I · §1
sourceLane.quote: All legislative Powers herein granted shall be vested in a Congress of the United States.
sourceLane.sourceName: Congress.gov — Constitution literal print, Article I
sourceLane.establishes: Legislative power is delegated through a defined institution and limited by the words “herein granted.”

sourceLane.title: Executive and judicial separation
sourceLane.label: ARTICLES II–III
sourceLane.quote: The executive Power shall be vested in a President ... The judicial Power ... in one supreme Court.
sourceLane.sourceName: Congress.gov — Constitution literal print, Articles II–III
sourceLane.establishes: Different governmental functions are assigned to different constitutional institutions.

sourceLane.title: Officer accountability
sourceLane.label: ARTICLE VI · CLAUSE 3
sourceLane.quote: All executive and judicial Officers ... shall be bound by Oath or Affirmation, to support this Constitution.
sourceLane.sourceName: Congress.gov — Constitution literal print, Article VI
sourceLane.establishes: Officials are bound to support the constitutional structure rather than become its source.

inversionLane.title: Institution becomes identity
inversionLane.body: A docket, database entry, status code, or institutional narrative stands in for the person who originated the claim or authority.
inversionLane.test: Can the person trace and correct the identity-bearing source record?

inversionLane.title: Delegated power becomes original power
inversionLane.body: An office acts as if its role, data, or workflow is self-justifying instead of showing the legal source, limit, and purpose of the delegation.
inversionLane.test: What exact power was delegated, to which role, under what limit, and for what public function?

inversionLane.title: Administration becomes adjudication
inversionLane.body: Receipt, formatting, classification, or a clerk’s record is treated as a factual finding that only an authorized decision-maker can make.
inversionLane.test: Is the item labeled received, checked, alleged, contested, or found?

inversionLane.title: Representation outranks the person
inversionLane.body: The institutional copy is treated as more real than the person’s testimony, contrary evidence, or source documents.
inversionLane.test: Can the affected person see the provenance, challenge the representation, and obtain a reasoned correction?

inversionLane.title: Procedure becomes a power barrier
inversionLane.body: Notice, access, timing, or technical requirements make it impossible for the person to exercise the authority the architecture nominally preserves.
inversionLane.test: Was notice meaningful, was access available, and was the response path usable in context?

inversionLane.title: Funding rewards the inversion
inversionLane.body: Budgets and contracts reward throughput, closure, enforcement, or data capture while correction, care, independent review, and lived outcomes remain invisible.
inversionLane.test: What function is paid, what metric triggers payment, and who bears the cost of error?

priorityTests.name: Source
priorityTests.question: Can every identity-bearing record point to a person, source, time, authority, and purpose?

priorityTests.name: Delegation
priorityTests.question: What power was delegated, by whom, to which role, with what limit and review path?

priorityTests.name: Function
priorityTests.question: Is this actor administering a record, running a deterministic check, or making a contextual legal finding?

priorityTests.name: Evidence
priorityTests.question: Is a claim still labeled as a claim, or did the record silently become a finding?

priorityTests.name: Return path
priorityTests.question: Can the person see, contest, correct, appeal, and obtain a remedy?

priorityTests.name: Incentive
priorityTests.question: Does funding support care, accuracy, correction, and oversight—or only throughput and closure?
